subject: DPA execution: audit evidence, subprocessors & eSign flow
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: DPA scope + audit evidence request

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal has asked us to confirm a few items before we can proceed to signature:

- We need confirmation that Redwood will permit a limited audit (on-site or remote) covering data handling controls tied to the DPA audit clause.
- Can you provide a SOC 2 summary and recent penetration test executive summary for our procurement packet?
- Any subprocessors that will have access to customer data for this deployment (region: us)? We need the subprocessor list and whether you have data transfer safeguards for cross-border subprocessors.

We'd like a response by end of week so procurement can queue DocuSign.

Thanks,
Jordan Lee
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Health

--
Note: Attaching our audit intake form separately (we will send the form after your reply).

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-29T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: DPA scope + audit evidence request

Jordan —

Appreciate the clarity. Short answers up front:
- We support limited remote audits under the DPA's audit clause; on-site is handled case-by-case for sensitive customers but we can accommodate remote evidence review (screenshare + document bundle).
- Attached I'll follow up with our SOC 2 summary and a pen-test executive summary; I’m looping in Rishi (security) and Marissa (legal) for the specifics on subprocessors and any redlines.
- Subprocessor inventory: we'll provide the current list and indicate which have cross-border transfer implications and our SCCs/KMS controls.

Next steps: Marissa to propose a clean DPA that includes the agreed audit modality and redline any specific procurement language. Rishi will attach the compliance artifacts. Once both are ready we can send via DocuSign for signature.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Draft DPA redlines and audit modality

Jordan & team,

Attached is a marked-up DPA (DPA_Redlines_Marissa_v1.docx) with two items highlighted that I expect you to review:
1) Audit logistics: we propose "remote evidence review" as the default with the option for a time-limited, mutually agreed on-site visit for critical incidents; we included a 30-day notice and scope-limitation clause.
2) Subprocessor disclosure: we added a requirement to provide a current inventory and 30-day notice for additions that materially affect data transfers.

If those points are acceptable, I'll prepare a clean execution copy and generate a DocuSign envelope. If Acme needs on-site audit language we can discuss scope and reciprocity (and any associated costs).

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachment: DPA_Redlines_Marissa_v1.docx (redline)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-30T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Compliance artifacts (SOC 2 summary + pen test executive summary)

Jordan —

Pasting a short executive summary below and attaching files to this thread: redwood_SOC2_summary_v3.pdf and 2026-11-30-pen-test-report-summary.txt.

Executive summary:
- SOC 2 Type II (security, availability, confidentiality) most recent audited period: Q2–Q3 2026. No exceptions.
- Penetration test: third-party red team completed Aug 2026; issues classified and remediated. Executive summary attached with high-level risk categories.
- Subprocessors: see attached inventory CSV (included in drive link). Cross-border subprocessors are limited; where transfers occur we rely on SCCs and customer-accessible KMS controls.

If Acme wants the full SOC report under an NDA we can provide a copy through our security intake process; remote review is typically sufficient for procurement.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft DPA redlines and audit modality

Thanks, team — this is helpful. A couple quick clarifications from Acme legal/procurement:
- Remote evidence review is acceptable. We'll want the SOC 2 summary and pen test exec for procurement packet (already received).
- For the subprocessor inventory: please confirm the CSV includes service provider location and whether data is stored/processed in EU/UK (even if our deployment is US).
- DocuSign flow: once the clean DPA is ready, we’ll countersign and route to procurement.

Can you send the clean DPA today so we can start routing?

—Priya
